definitions.nominal_ideal_box_score: Original noiseless ideal box projection declared by the generator; not measured robust SNR or flux.
definitions.global_maximum_robust_score: Saved maximum of the robust detector statistic across searched templates in an ON scan, not a truth-localized statistic.
definitions.global_maximum_divided_by_nominal_ideal: Descriptive ratio of a selected search maximum to a noiseless ideal projection; not an estimator of efficiency, SNR recovery or flux calibration.
definitions.ALL: Every active ON scan has an original truth-localized surviving hit.
definitions.ANY: At least one active ON scan has an original truth-localized surviving hit.
definitions.median: statistics.median: middle sorted value or arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even sample size.
definitions.independence: No independence claimed for scans within cases or template/carrier responses.
definitions.design: One realization per level x drift x intrinsic width x activity cell; placement margins balanced but placement interactions not fully replicated.

groups.scan_weighting: Each active ON scan contributes one saved global maximum; scans within a case are not independent trials.
